response.reasoning: The diff confirms all elements of the finding: db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb creates the table with only `t.string :host, null: false` and `t.integer :category_id, null: false` — no unique index on host. app/models/embeddable_host.rb only does `validates_format_of :host` with no uniqueness validation, and `record_for_host` does `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` with no ORDER BY. The controller's save_host simply calls `host.save`, so an admin can add the same host twice with different categories, and TopicEmbed.import uses `eh.try(:category_id)` from this arbitrary `.first`, producing unpredictable category assignment. This is a real, verifiable defect in the new per-host category mechanism (previously a single global embed_category setting avoided this ambiguity).
